purpose: Defines the single-writer background daemon service, fast sub-10ms hook handlers, worker pipeline loop, and macOS LaunchAgent lifecycle management for Lumen. STATUS (2026-08-21): unimplemented -- lumen-daemon does not exist as a crate in this workspace. SPEC-LUMEN-008-CLI's rescoped current CLI (trace/audit/ingest/sessions/session) reads and writes lumen-store directly and does not depend on this daemon; the daemon architecture remains this spec's legitimate target but is not currently being built toward. Do not assume any acceptance criterion below is satisfied without checking crates/ for a lumen-daemon package first.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-daemon: DaemonServer, HookHandler, WorkerPipeline, LaunchAgentManager, and DaemonConfig.
non_goals: Terminal TUI presentation or user command line interfaces (handled by lumen-cli).
Evaluation sandboxing or grading execution (handled by prism-core).
Category-score computation and discovered-category clustering (handled by lumen-insights, not yet integrated into WorkerPipeline's transaction).

api_surface.name: DaemonServer
api_surface.signature: pub struct DaemonServer { store: Arc<SqliteStore>, config: DaemonConfig, socket_path: Utf8PathBuf }; impl DaemonServer { pub async fn run(&self) -> Result<(), DaemonError>; pub fn start_background() -> Result<u32, DaemonError>; pub fn stop() -> Result<(), DaemonError>; }
api_surface.description: Background service owning the single SQLite WAL write connection, listening on a local Unix domain socket, and driving the worker queue loop.
error_conditions: DaemonError::SocketBindFailed if local Unix domain socket is in use or inaccessible
DaemonError::AlreadyRunning if daemon PID lockfile exists and process is live

api_surface.name: HookHandler
api_surface.signature: pub struct HookHandler; impl HookHandler { pub fn handle_enqueue(provider: &str, session_id: &str, path: &str) -> Result<(), DaemonError>; pub fn handle_snapshot(provider: &str, session_id: &str, data: &[u8]) -> Result<(), DaemonError>; }
api_surface.description: Fast-path hook entrypoints invoked by Claude Code PreCompact/Stop hooks or AGY lifecycle triggers.

api_surface.name: WorkerPipeline
api_surface.signature: pub struct WorkerPipeline { store: Arc<SqliteStore> }; impl WorkerPipeline { pub async fn run_once(&self, item: QueuedSessionRow) -> Result<(), DaemonError>; }
api_surface.description: Drains one queued session: adapter normalization, accumulator execution, fact-row inserts via lumen-store repositories, and queue completion, all within a single SQLite transaction.
error_conditions: DaemonError::TranscriptUnparseable if adapter normalization fails (handled by CRIT-LUMEN-054's retry path, not a hard failure)

api_surface.name: LaunchAgentManager
api_surface.signature: pub struct LaunchAgentManager; impl LaunchAgentManager { pub fn install() -> Result<(), DaemonError>; pub fn uninstall() -> Result<(), DaemonError>; pub fn is_installed() -> bool; pub fn status() -> Result<ServiceStatus, DaemonError>; }
api_surface.description: Manages the macOS LaunchAgent plist (~/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.techworx.lumen.daemon.plist) and maintains compatibility with the stubhub-ai-telemetry binary alias.
error_conditions: DaemonError::PlistWriteFailed if LaunchAgents directory is not writable

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN lumen daemon enqueue is invoked by a Stop hook, THE SYSTEM SHALL record the session row into the ingestion queue in under 10 milliseconds p95 without performing transcript parsing.

WHEN lumen daemon snapshot is invoked by a PreCompact hook, THE SYSTEM SHALL call SnapshotRepository::save_snapshot(provider, session_id, data) to persist the pre-compaction BLOB into session_snapshots in under 50 milliseconds p95.
WHEN the daemon starts up, THE SYSTEM SHALL acquire an exclusive PID lockfile and refuse to start if another instance is already running.

WHEN WorkerPipeline::run_once processes a queued session, THE SYSTEM SHALL run adapter normalization, execute the 22 accumulators, insert their outputs via ToolCallRepository::insert_tool_calls, CommandEventRepository::insert_command_events, TokenUsageRepository::insert_token_usage, and FindingsRepository::insert_findings, then call QueueRepository::mark_completed(id) — all within a single SQLite transaction. Category-score and discovered-category aggregation (session_category_scores, discovered_categories) is out of scope for this transaction; those tables are populated by a separate downstream lumen-insights stage once that crate exists.
IF a transcript is corrupted or unparseable, THE SYSTEM SHALL catch the error, increment retry_count, schedule exponential backoff, and avoid crashing the daemon process.
WHEN lumen daemon install is executed on macOS, THE SYSTEM SHALL generate and load a LaunchAgent plist configured for RunAtLoad and KeepAlive.
WHEN lumen daemon uninstall is executed, THE SYSTEM SHALL unload the LaunchAgent service, delete the plist file, and clean up socket artifacts.
WHEN SIGINT or SIGTERM is received, THE SYSTEM SHALL complete any in-flight SQLite transaction and gracefully shut down within 500 milliseconds.

reasoning: Establishes the single-writer daemon service, sub-10ms hook budgets, worker queue execution, and LaunchAgent lifecycle management.
